_readme: Written automatically every Monday by .github/workflows/trending.yml from share-link visits logged in D1 (see functions/api/sv.js). Fewer than three slugs means fewer than three listings got share visits that week; an empty list hides the bar. "previous" is last week's order, used only for the up/down/new markers. Editing by hand still works, but the next Monday run will overwrite it.
